envelope.description: Update the live documentation and the doc test

body.title: Update the live documentation and the doc test
body.summary: Update docs/daemon.md, docs/workflow.md (including the shell example that writes the file by hand and the tree listing), docs/installation.md, docs/index.html and the plans under docs/plans to name repo-config.json and INSRC_REPO_CONFIG, state that an existing github.json is moved at the first boot of the updated daemon and that a github.json created by hand afterwards is ignored because the settings now live in repo-config.json, and extend build-commands-doc.test.ts to keep this section equal to the code. Approved Story and Epic records are left as they are.
acceptanceChecks: The live docs name repo-config.json and INSRC_REPO_CONFIG and none of them tells a user to create github.json.
The docs state that an existing github.json is moved at the first boot of the updated daemon and that a github.json created by hand afterwards is ignored.
build-commands-doc.test.ts passes and fails when the docs name a different file or variable than the code.
Approved Story and Epic records under docs/standalone and docs/epics are unchanged.

tests.name: build-commands-doc.test.ts: docs/daemon.md and the other live docs name repo-config.json and INSRC_REPO_CONFIG in line with the code
